The '''Battle of Oasis''' was an attack of the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]] on the moon [[Oasis (moon)|Oasis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The pirates attempted to crash the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] into the base of [[Rodin Higron]]'s [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] but they were repelled by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="RotM" />
